Subject: Quick: EOQ close — one-time credit to accelerate pilot

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. The NexaHealth pilot looks like a great fit and the team is excited about the integration. To help unblock procurement and get you across the finish line this quarter, we can offer a one-time conversion credit to cover additional pilot usage and a short runway for go-live testing.

Proposed offer (one-time, non-recurring):
- $20,000 platform credit applied to the pilot account (usable for inference tokens & embeddings)
- Valid for consumption over 60 days after acceptance
- Requires signature on the updated SOW/addendum and a standard pilot MSA addendum

If that sounds reasonable I can loop in our finance/ops team for quick approval and send the DocuSign. Would you be able to accept by EOD Wednesday (10/27) so we can do a fast turnaround this quarter?

Attaching a short one-pager that summarizes how the credit will be applied and the usage window.

Best,

Kim, Ben —

Finance is good with a one-time consumption credit of $20,000 for NexaHealth under the following controls:
- Credit must be documented in an addendum: one-time credit amount, expiration date (60 days), and account ID mapped to the NexaHealth pilot.
- Credit is non-refundable and cannot be converted to cash or invoice credits.
- Legal needs an authorized sign-off on the SOW/addendum; procurement should receive the exact clause language.
- We should cap internal approvals to two signatories (Ben + Kim) for this amount; Marcus will counter-sign after legal OK.
